output.title: New opt-in ingress-shim flag; no evidence of Ingress use
output.content: The change adds an optional ingress-shim flag, `--extra-certificate-annotations`, which copies listed annotation keys from Ingress-like objects to the resulting Certificate. The environment shows no ingress-shim flag configuration. Its values keys are only global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled, prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort and replicaCount. The manifests contain only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, with no Ingress or Gateway resources. The release note describes an added feature only, with no changed default, so nothing changes unless the operator opts in.
